svg.title: Hyperscale Lead Times, Buildings Versus Power
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-hyperscale-lead-time-bars; chapter number: 2; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Hyperscale Lead Times, Buildings Versus Power; subtitle: Buildings rise faster than the grid, transformers and turbines can arrive; unit: years; caption: Power, not chips or buildings, is the scarce input; order long-lead electrical gear immediately because you cannot download another transformer.; assumptions note: Min and max are the cited ranges. Typical is the midpoint of each cited range, shown only for bar placement. Grid gear is cited as two-plus years and plotted at 2. Turbine waits span the practitioner disagreement from 2-3 years to more than 5.; note: Transformer and grid gear lead times attributed to BUILT BENEATH (7L7MfK9coTY); early ordering guidance from MEP Engineer AJ (lTK_pU1_uFc); bottleneck framing from The Power Engineer (BWtk0CSPH6g).; bars: label: Building construction; min: 1.5; max: 3; typical: 2.25; display: 18 months to 3 years; label: Grid gear delivery; min: 2; max: 2; typical: 2; display: Two-plus years; label: Gas turbine wait; min: 2; max: 5; typical: 3.5; display: 2-3 years to more than 5; label: Large transformer lead time; min: 3; max: 4; typical: 3.5; display: 3-4 years; label: Grid connection wait; min: 4; max: 5; typical: 4.5; display: 4-5 years
